guideline_id: ESC-2026-VHD-4.2
issuing_body: ESC

evidence_level: Class I
context_tags: [valve, TAVI, annulus, MR]
---

Valve selection by annulus sizing. In patients with severe symptomatic aortic
stenosis referred for transcatheter aortic valve implantation, cardiac CT and
cardiac MR imaging of the aortic annulus is mandatory before valve selection.
For an annulus measuring 26-29 mm on cardiac imaging, the recommendation is
selection of a 29 mm transcatheter heart valve (Class I). This
guideline-directed management pathway requires that the EF, ventricular
function and annulus measurements are documented in the structural heart
report. The recommendation is grounded in cardiac imaging workup: annular
dimensions, left ventricular function and the planned transcatheter valve
size must all be cross-checked. Multidisciplinary heart team review of the
cardiac imaging and the EF precedes any transcatheter valve procedure. When
annulus measurements fall outside 26-29 mm, alternative valve sizes follow
the manufacturer sizing tables, and repeat cardiac imaging is advised before
a final management recommendation is issued.
